show.description: A poor vegetable seller, rejected and humiliated by everyone, discovers he is the true heir to a trillionaire empire. Choosing to hide his identity, he joins his own company as an intern. While his ex-girlfriend and a fake heir insult him, he quietly plans his comeback. Amid love, power, betrayal, and revenge. How long before the truth explodes and changes everything?
